name: Atacama Desert
about: Days are pleasant most of the year, nights are cold, and the brief "Bolivian winter" (Jan–Feb) can bring rare storms.
overview: Mars-red salt flats, geysers, and star-clear night skies in one of the driest places on Earth.
costOverview: Food and coffee in San Pedro town are reasonable, but nearly every real activity here — salt flats, geysers, lagoons — requires a paid guided tour.
monthlyWeather: warm by day and mild at night, with a small chance of rare summer storms
